4314.title: Slow-reader relay buffers without flow control
4314.rootCauseOneLine: The gate copies each response chunk into a stalled write chain while the tunnel client has no gate-capacity signal to stop reading the origin.

prReviews.topFinding: Tunnel reset recovery leaves the response write chain unbounded.

4314.proposedFix: Introduce versioned per-stream pause/resume flow control and verify bounded memory with slow readers and older clients.
4314.caveats: The local test did not reproduce a Cloudflare memory reset.
